comment: Glamourer IPC response: Glamourer.GetStateBase64(0, 0) — decompressed JSON

notes.Equipment: Each slot has ItemId + Stain (dye). Empty slots = not equipped.
notes.Customize: Character appearance data. Varies by race/gender.
notes.Mods: Glamourer's mod association. Enabled mods are turned ON when design is applied. Remove=true mods are turned OFF (to prevent conflicts).
notes.Stain: 0 = no dye, 1-128 = dye color IDs from FFXIV
